titles.romaji: Pocket Monsters Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire: Mega Special Animation
titles.english: Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Animated Trailer
titles.native: ポケットモンスター オメガルビー・アルファサファイア』 メガスペシャルアニメーション

description:
The Pokémon Company streamed the "Mega Special Animation" short inspired by the upcoming Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire games on Sunday. The short features Pokémon undergoing the newly discovered Mega Evolution and Primal Reversion in the Hoenn region.

(Source: Anime News Network)
